name: Pix2Pix Denoising Network for Point Clouds
definition: A generative adversarial network (GAN) based method to denoise point cloud renderings. It uses a generator to map noisy splat images to clean splat images and a discriminator to distinguish real from generated images, trained on pairs rendered via Differentiable Surface Splatting (DSS).
summary: A GAN-based method that denoises point clouds by mapping noisy splat images to clean ones via image-to-image translation, then updating 3D geometry through Differentiable Surface Splatting to recover sharp features.
